resolvedProductionDefects.verifiedResolution: An exact two-ID retirement guard suppresses captured obsolete cleanup closures; retirement transaction removes only those owners' cached bindings. Final old-world load verifies all three retired variants have zero bindings and preserves V12/foreign NBT.

resolvedProductionDefects.verifiedResolution: Only the admitted same-UUID loaded-BE migration adapter waives entity obstruction for automatic rebaking. Ordinary placement and rotation keep their original entity policy. Final old-world test reproduces ordinary refusal and verifies migration completion with the same living entity retained.
